title: Powerwall Battery Cycle and Reserve Tracking
dataSources: SolarEdge/Enphase production (`solaredge:power`, `enphase:production`), Powerwall (`powerwall:aggregate`), smart-meter P1/DSMR (`dsmr:telegram`), Emporia Vue (`emporia:circuit`).
app: Solar inverters (SolarEdge/Enphase/Fronius/Growatt), Tesla Powerwall, and smart meters (P1/DSMR, Emporia Vue, Sense) via vendor APIs and MQTT to HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=powerwall:aggregate
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(battery_discharge_wh) as discharged, min(soc_pct) as min_soc, max(soc_pct) as max_soc by _time
| eval cycles=round(discharged/13500,2)
| sort - _time
description: Estimates how many full battery cycles your home battery does each day and how low it drains, which drives both savings and long-term battery health.
value: Cycle count is the main wear factor for a home battery; tracking it helps you balance bill savings against battery longevity.
implementation: Ingest Powerwall aggregate data; schedule daily and review cycles and minimum state of charge.
visualization: Chart of daily battery cycles and state-of-charge range.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks how hard your home battery works each day, which affects both your savings and how long the battery lasts.
